description: A tiny relevance test set over sample_corpus.json for Chapter 9. Each query lists the document ids judged relevant (binary relevance). Real evaluation sets are larger and often use graded relevance, but this is enough to learn and compare metrics.

queries.query: a large animal that lives in the ocean
strong pain on one side of the head
what is the capital city of a country
how do you measure whether two sentences say the same thing
what makes precipitation fall from the sky
where does a country run its parliament from
do any sea creatures feed their babies milk
